title: Model, EAGLE, KiCad, JSON, model
how: Chain: model to EAGLE, then to KiCad, then to the canonical JSON and back. The board has 3 components (R1, R2 turned 90 degrees, J1 turned 180 degrees) = 6 placed pads, 2 nets, 4 pad nets, a track of 2 pieces and a track of 1 piece = 3 pieces,
1 via, 1 zone and an outline of 4 points; these counts and the positions of the pads, the via, the track ends and the outline points, the references with their values,
the net names and the pad net names are compared after the chain, with the tolerance written in the entry.
